title: Light of the Breaker
next_chapter_hook: Although the dimensional crisis had been quelled, when Chen Ji looked up at the heavens and sensed the Eye of Heavenly Dao gazing upon him with a gaze that transcended time and space, he knew the true ultimate showdown—the fate battle of Chapter 1155—had become inevitable.

text.content: Dawn's light pierced through the chaotic mist above the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the edge of the Star-Plucking Cliff's precipice, his robes billowing in the wind. His gaze penetrated the layers of clouds, as if trying to see the incomprehensible source of Heavenly Dao. Last night, the Tianji Record Fragment had appeared again, revealing a shocking truth—the dimensional threat was merely a discarded piece in Heavenly Dao's chess game, and he, Chen Ji, was being pushed step by step toward the center of the board. "Tianji Record," he murmured softly, his fingertips caressing the yellowed pages, "what do you want me to see?" Suddenly, the golden runes on the fragment trembled violently, and a complete image that had never appeared before surfaced before his eyes: Chapter 1155, heaven and earth collapsing, his final showdown with the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: "You finally saw it." Mo Xiansheng's aged voice drifted from the fragment, carrying a hint of imperceptible relief. "A thousand-year layout, thirteen generations of inheritors—all were your stepping stones. Chen Ji, you are the Breaker chosen by the Tianji Record to break the cycle—but once you set foot on this path, there is no turning back." Chen Ji's gaze condensed slightly, yet a faint, tranquil curve appeared at the corner of his mouth: "No turning back? I crawled out of a pile of corpses to begin with. Am I afraid of dying again?"

text.content: Before his words finished, a sharp sword intent came swooping from behind. Chen Ji's form didn't move, yet brilliant starlight suddenly radiated around him—that was the protective prohibition granted by the Tianji Record. The sword light stopped abruptly three feet away. Su Qingyao stood there with her sword, her usually cold face showing rare anxiety. "Chen Ji, you left the Inner Sect alone last night. What were you planning to do?" Her voice carried several degrees of interrogation, yet deep worry hid beneath her eyes. Chen Ji turned around, and a smile that made her heart skip suddenly bloomed on his seemingly timid face: "Su Senior Sister, coming to find me so early—is it because you're worried about me?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's face flushed slightly, yet the tip of her sword didn't waver: "Don't try to change the subject. The dimensional rift's disturbance has already alarmed the three major sects. Han Lie from the Xuanwu Sect is rushing over, and Ye Qing from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path has also sent word that she wants to see you—what are you really planning?" She paused, her voice dropping: "The aura of the Tianji Record... I sensed it last night. That's not the fluctuation a fragment should have." Chen Ji looked at this confidante who had approached the truth multiple times, then sighed softly: "Su Senior Sister, are you certain you want to know? Once some truths are understood, there's no turning back."

text.content: Su Qingyao gave no answer, but her action of sheathing her sword was the best response. Just as Chen Ji was about to speak, the sky suddenly tore open with a deep, dark fissure. Purple-black mist gushed out, instantly covering half the sky. A graceful yet eerie figure stepped out slowly from the rift—it was precisely the Holy Sect's Saint Maiden Ye Qing. Her face was pale as paper. When she saw Chen Ji, fear flickered in her pupils: "Chen Ji, the prophecy you gave me... I saw the ending." Her voice trembled slightly, "The dimensional master's consciousness has begun to awaken. It wants to descend using my body."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned cold in an instant, yet the next second he restored his calm, water-like composure: "So you came to me, asking me to help you escape the Holy Sect's control, or wanting to use the dimensional master's power to retaliate against them?" Ye Qing's form trembled, clearly having her心事 exposed. Yet Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of playfulness: "Saint Maiden, you've forgotten what I can see. The Tianji Record has already told me—you want to survive, and I can give you this opportunity." He paused, then shifted topics: "But the price is, you must become a bright piece on my chessboard."

text.content: At that moment, a roar that shattered mountains and rivers came from the depths of the heavens. A giant eye condensed from pure Heavenly Dao laws slowly opened—that was the true projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Countless purple-golden thunders poured down from the eye, enveloping the entire Tianqing Sect. Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind: "It's here! It's attacking early! You must make a choice before your Heavenly Fate Value runs out—" Chen Ji closed his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment burned furiously within him, his Heavenly Fate Value depleting visibly. Yet the images before his eyes grew increasingly clear: continue laying plans and wait for the opportune moment, rest and conserve strength to accumulate power, or take the initiative to strike at the dragon's den.

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure descended like mountains toppling. Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value was rapidly depleting. In this critical moment, you must make a choice:

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record's foresight ability, quietly retreat before the Eye of Heavenly Dao descends, disguising everything as an accident. You will gain more preparation time, but the Eye of Heavenly Dao will also sense your retreat.
choices.visible_reward: Gain "First Move" buff: All judgments for the next three chapters +2
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will regard you as a predictable opponent, reducing its attention toward you

text.content: A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. The Tianji Record Fragment in his hand suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light. In that flash of lightning, he captured the attack trajectory of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—northwest direction, a flaw would appear after three breaths. "Go!" he shouted. With one arm around Su Qingyao's waist and the other grabbing Ye Qing's wrist, he vanished from the spot with footwork that compressed the earth. The next second, the place where they had stood was smashed to smithereens by purple-golden thunder.

Su Qingyao was held in his arms, her heart pounding like war drums, yet in those deep eyes she saw determination and coldness she had never witnessed before. "Is this the real you?" she murmured softly. Chen Ji gave no answer, only bringing her and Ye Qing to a hidden cave beneath Star-Plucking Cliff before releasing them. His expressionindifferent地说："Itook note of this，wait for thethe right moment." That tone wascalm得可怕，as if the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure was merely mosquito humming.

choices.description: Abandon direct confrontation with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, retreat to the sect's forbidden grounds, and use the Tianji Record's sealing power to stabilize injuries. You will restore all Heavenly Fate Value, but will miss the best opportunity to expose the truth.
choices.visible_cost: Lose trust with Su Qingyao and Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Fate Value completely restored, gain "Heavenly Dao Ignores" status for 24 hours
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie will gain fortuitous encounter during your rest, greatly increasing his strength

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, pulling the two women into the forbidden grounds beneath Star-Plucking Cliff. This place was covered with sealing formations left by generations of sect leaders, which slowly illuminated under the Tianji Record's activation, enveloping all three in a soft golden light. Disappointment showed on Su Qingyao's face, yet she still chose to sit shoulder to shoulder with him. Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji thoughtfully, a complex light flickering in her eyes.

"You're afraid." Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice carrying a hint of heartache. Chen Ji was stunned for a moment, then shook his head: "Not afraid, it's... I don't want you to see me fail." He spoke softly, so softly it seemed he was speaking to himself. Ye Qing chuckled lightly: "Chen Ji, you really are... hard to figure out." The three of them cultivated in silence within the forbidden grounds. Outside the cave, the Eye of Heavenly Dao, finding nothing after searching, slowly receded into the Void.

choices.description: Burning all Heavenly Fate Value, pushing the foresight power of the Tianji Record to its limit, directly locking onto the weakness of the Heavenly Eye for a fatal strike. High risk, high reward, but the cost is that after this battle you will fall into extreme weakness.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes 80 points of Heavenly Fate Value, falling into a weakened state
choices.visible_reward: First time dealing substantial damage to the Heavenly Eye, unlocking the title 'Breaker'
choices.risk_hint: If attacked by enemies during the weakened state, there will be no ability to resist

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, only taking out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, letting the golden runes burn away completely. Heavenly Fate Value poured out like a breaching flood, his hair turning white as snow in an instant, yet those eyes burned with startling brilliance. 'I see you.' He murmured softly, stomping hard, transforming into a streak of light that lunged toward the Heavenly Eye. Su Qingyao cried out in alarm, while Ye Qing's pupils shook violently—she saw in that streak of light the very ending Chen Ji had prophesied for her. The Breaker, that slash of light cutting through the darkness.

All the power of the Tianji Record erupted at this moment. Chen Ji felt as if he had become the antithesis of the heavens themselves, colliding violently with that giant eye. 'Breaker Light—' His voice exploded through the void as he thrust out a finger, golden light and purple-gold thunder annihilating each other. The Heavenly Eye let out an angry howl, then abruptly contracted—it was injured, truly injured! Chen Ji plummeted from the sky, crashing hard onto Star-Grabbing Cliff, spitting out a large mouthful of blood, yet he laughed: 'So this is what it feels like to break the chessboard.' On that pale face, those eyes burned with startling brilliance.

Chen Ji lay weakly on the ground. Su Qingyao and Ye Qing rushed to his side simultaneously. Su Qingyao's eyes were red-rimmed, yet spiritual healing light was already gathering in her hands: 'You madman!' Her voice trembled. Chen Ji struggled to curl the corner of his lips: 'Senior Sister Su, are you crying?' Ye Qing gazed at him with complex emotions, then suddenly knelt on one knee: 'Chen Ji, from this day forth, I, Ye Qing, pledge to serve you unto death.' Her voice no longer carried its usual allure, only reverent devotion from the depths of her soul. Chen Ji weakly reached out his hand, touching Su Qingyao's cheek, then looked at Ye Qing: 'Death service isn't necessary... but next time, remember to call me along for the madness.'

dialogue.content: Just then, the Heavenly Eye that had retreated into the void suddenly reconverged. A will surpassing the soul directly transmitted into Chen Ji's mind: 'Interesting... the first existence in a thousand years to wound this one.' That voice was ancient and majestic, without anger, only pure scrutiny. 'Chen Ji, this one remembers you. In Chapter 1155, this one shall play chess with you personally—then, you shall understand what true heavenly way is.' Chen Ji forced himself upright, grinning: 'Heavenly way? You're just an old thing born a few trillion years earlier than me. Wait until I drag you off the chessboard, and let's see how you keep pretending.' That laughter was weak yet audacious. Su Qingyao tightly gripped his hand, saying nothing.

text.content: Inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, the atmosphere was heavy as iron. Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, and deep within those murky old eyes flickered a sinister gleam. When Chen Ji entered the hall supported by Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, the old Sect Master's lips curved into a meaningful smile: 'Nephew Chen Ji, I hear you severely wounded the projection of the Heavenly Eye? What great boldness.' Chen Ji straightened his body, weak yet his spine rigid as a spear: 'Your disciple is terrified, just lucky dogshit. But Master-Uncle, sitting in this main seat, have you considered that the Heavenly Eye's next target is the Tianqing Sect?' Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed, and other elders in the hall showed signs of alarm.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's smile froze for an instant, then recovered: 'What does Nephew Chen Ji mean by this?' Chen Ji took a Jade Slip from his chest, casually tossing it toward Ling Yuan: 'During this disciple's confrontation with the Heavenly Eye, I happened to foresee a glimpse—a corner of the vision. The destruction of Tianqing Sect, in one month. And the one who triggers all this...' He paused, his gaze sharp as a blade piercing toward Ling Yuan, 'is an insider within the Sect.' The hall erupted in uproar. Ling Yuan's expression thoroughly darkened, and that murky gaze finally revealed true killing intent. Chen Ji acted as if he saw nothing, merely saying softly: 'Of course, this is merely this disciple's wild speculation. Master-Uncle need not take it seriously.'

text.content: That smile, in Ling Yuan's eyes, was more chilling than any threat. The old Sect Master's fingers trembled slightly within his sleeve, yet his face still wore that benevolent expression: 'Nephew Chen Ji's joke is a bit too grand.' Chen Ji shook his head, his tone sincere yet terrifying: 'How would this disciple dare mock Master-Uncle? It's just that after that battle, this disciple's Tianji Record seems to have become a bit more complete... what can be seen is also growing more.' He slightly tilted his head, looking at Ling Yuan with a knowing smile, 'For instance... how the previous generation's inheritor was eliminated.' Ling Yuan's face instantly turned ashen. The air in the hall seemed to solidify. Su Qingyao felt that oppressive pressure and unconsciously gripped her sword hilt tighter.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly stepped forward, shielding Chen Ji, coldly saying: 'Sect Master, Brother Chen Ji is still gravely wounded. Perhaps we could discuss matters after his recovery.' Ling Yuan's gaze lingered on Su Qingyao for a moment, then suddenly smiled: 'Very well. Qingyao, you shall take care of Nephew Chen Ji then.' His tone was gentle, yet a trace of ruthlessness flickered in his eyes, 'After all... he is a hero of our Tianqing Sect.' With that, he swept his sleeve and left. Other elders also took their leave, leaving only silence and undercurrents in the hall.

text.content: After the hall doors closed, Su Qingyao finally turned around, looking at the pale-faced Chen Ji. Her eyes held worry, tenderness, and a trace of emotion she herself couldn't quite name: 'Why did you provoke him like that just now?' Chen Ji smiled weakly, leaning against the pillar: 'Because I need him to panic.' His gaze suddenly turned sharp, 'A panicked person reveals flaws. Ling Yuan has hidden for too long. I need him to expose his own tail.' Ye Qing emerged from the shadows, speaking softly: 'But your current state...' Chen Ji waved his hand: 'Relax, I still have one card left to play.' His gaze越过两个女子，望向远方，'韩烈应该快到了吧？'
仿佛是为了印证他的话，殿外传来一阵剧烈的震动。一个魁梧的身影大步流星地闯入，身后跟着数名玄武宗弟子。韩烈浑身杀气腾腾，见到陈机的瞬间，二话不说便一拳轰出：'陈机！今日我便要看看，没了那些阴谋诡计，你还能如何brazen！'拳风呼啸，带着足以碎裂山岳的恐怖力量。苏青瑶拔剑欲挡，却被陈机一把拉住。他就那样站在原地，看着那足以将他碾成齑粉的一拳，嘴角忽然勾起一抹sarcastic的弧度。

choice.prompt: 韩烈的拳头已近在咫尺，玄武宗第一天才的怒火足以焚尽一切。在这电光火石之间，你如何应对这突如其来的挑战？

choices.description: 韩烈最恨别人说他有勇无谋，只需一句话便能让他失去理智。你将不费吹灰之力让他当众出丑，但也会彻底结下死仇。
choices.process_label: words cut deep, strike the heart

text.content: 陈机纹丝不动，只是在拳风即将触及面门的瞬间，轻飘飘地说了一句：'韩公子，上次输给我的那一拳，练回来了吗？'韩烈的动作suddenly一滞，瞳孔中燃起熊熊怒火。陈机嘴角的sarcastic愈发明显：'可惜啊，练了这么久，还是这么慢。'那语气轻描淡写，却比任何污言秽语都要刺耳百倍。韩烈彻底失去理智，拳头不顾一切地砸向陈机——却砸在了一面suddenly浮现的金色光幕之上，反震之力将他弹飞出去，在地上滚了三圈。
殿中一片死寂，玄武宗的弟子们面面相觑，脸上火辣辣的疼。韩烈从地上爬起来，双目赤红，却忽然仰天大笑：'好！好一个陈机！我韩烈今日记住了！'他转身便走，走到门口时忽然回头，'下次见面，我必杀你！'陈机weak地咳嗽两声，却还是笑着拱了拱手：'韩公子慢走，欢迎下次再来送脸。'夜清忍不住噗嗤一声笑出来，随即又赶紧捂住嘴。苏青瑶则是helpless地叹了口气，眼底却藏着笑意。

choices.description: 以柔克刚，利用韩烈的力量反将他震退。你将不落下风且不结死仇，但韩烈会认为你在戏耍他，hostility更深。
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, hide your trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie will become even more obsessed with seeking revenge against you

text.content: Chen Jislightly一侧身，以一个看似狼狈实则精妙的角度躲开了拳锋的核心，同时指尖轻轻搭上 Han Lie的手臂，借着他的力道轻轻一推。"Han公子，何必这么大的火气？"他的声音weak却平稳，身形踉跄后退两步，却恰好卸去了 Han Lie全部的力道。Han Lie瞳孔微缩，意识到对方根本没有出全力，这一刻的羞恼比furious更甚。

"你在戏弄我？" Han Lie咬牙切齿。Chen Ji摇摇头，神色serious："Han公子误会了，我只是……重伤未愈，没力气还手罢了。"那语气heartfelt得让人想揍他，Ye Qing在一旁看得目瞪口呆。Su Qingyao则是悄悄松了口气，她知道Chen Ji这是在故意示弱——这个男人的心机，比她想象的还要深百倍。Han Lie深吸一口气，拂袖而去："下次，我必杀你！"声音渐远，Chen Ji脸上的笑意却更深了。

Han Lie离去后，Chen Ji的身体终于支撑不住，瘫软在Su Qingyao怀中。Su Qingyao连忙扶住他，却见他脸色苍白如纸，嘴角却挂着满足的笑容。"你啊……"她轻轻叹了口气，眼眶微红，"明明已经伤成这样，还要逞强。"Chen Ji费力地抬起手，摸了摸她的脸颊："Su师姐，我答应你……等第1155章结束，我就把一切都告诉你。"他的声音很轻，却带着从未有过的solemn。Ye Qing默默站在一旁，看着这一幕，心中泛起一丝说不清的酸涩。

dialogue.content: Ye Qing忽然开口，声音里带着几分serious："Chen Ji，你说第1155章会有一场终极决战……我需要做什么？"Chen Ji看向她，眼底闪过一丝admiring："你的魔道迷雾可以遮掩天机录的气息。在最终决战之前，我需要你做三件事。"他伸出三根手指，"第一，监视Ling Yuan的一举一动；第二，在魔道圣宗内部散布消息，说维度之主的意识已经与我达成合作；第三……"他顿了顿，"找到Chen Nian。"提到妹妹的名字，他的眼神suddenly变得gentle而agonized。Su Qingyao和Ye Qing对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了同一个信息：Chen Nian，这个名字对Chen Ji而言，比天机录还要重要。

text.content: Ye Qingsolemn地点点头："我明白了。"她看向Su Qingyao，忽然说了一句让所有人都愣住的话，"Su首席，从今往后，我们便是同路人。"Su Qingyaoslightly一怔，随即明白了她的意思——她们都选择站在Chen Ji身后，无论前路如何艰险。Ye Qing转身离去，身影消失在阴影中之前，她回头看了Chen Ji一眼，眼中闪过一丝complex的光芒。Chen Ji靠在Su Qingyao肩头，看着Ye Qing离去的方向，忽然whispered说："谢谢你，Qingyao。"Su Qingyaowas momentarily stunned，随即轻轻握住了他的手。

三日后，摘星崖下的洞府之中。Chen Ji盘膝而坐，周身环绕着淡金色的灵光。fate在缓慢恢复，虽然离全盛时期还差得远，但至少已经脱离了危险。Mo Xiansheng的声音从残页中悠悠传来："Chen Ji，你这次做得很好。天机录又解封了一页知识……关于天道之眼的真正来历，以及它与维度之主的关系。"Chen Ji睁开眼睛，眸光深邃如渊："说。"Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻，才slowly开口："天道之眼并非天道本体的全部，它只是天道用来监视下界的工具——而真正的天道意志，潜伏在更深的维度之中。"

Chen Ji静静地听着，脑海中飞速整理着信息。Mo Xiansheng继续说道："千年前，天道之眼与维度之主曾是天道的左膀右臂，却因理念分歧而分道扬镳。维度之主追求的是打破轮回，让世间再无命运束缚；而天道之眼则要维持天道秩序，将一切命运都锁死在棋盘之上。"Chen Ji忽然开口："所以，天机录实际上是维度之主留下的后手？"Mo Xiansheng的声音里带着一丝approving："你猜对了一半。天机录是维度之主与某个……更古老的存在，共同创造的。"Chen Ji瞳孔微缩，那个"更古老的存在"，显然不是天道之眼。

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng的声音变得low："Chen Ji，有些真相你必须亲自去发现。但我可以告诉你一点——第1155章的终极决战，胜负的关键不在于你有多强，而在于你愿不愿意放弃一些东西。"Chen Ji沉默良久，忽然笑了："放弃？我Chen Ji从踏入修炼之路开始，就在不断失去。失去家族，失去妹妹，失去平凡的人生……"他的声音变得很轻，轻得像是说给自己听，"如果连最后这点执念都要失去，那我变强还有什么意义？"Mo Xiansheng没有回答，只是残页上的符文slightly闪烁，仿佛在sighing。

text.content: 洞府外传来脚步声，Su Qingyao端着一碗灵药走了进来。"喝药。"她的声音清冷，动作却很轻柔。Chen Ji接过药碗，一饮而尽，然后看着她："Qingyao，我想拜托你一件事。"Su Qingyaoslightly一怔——他叫她"Qingyao"，不是"Su师姐"。Chen Ji从怀中取出一枚玉简，递到她手中："这里面记录了天机录的部分能力，以及……我所有的布局。如果你有一天发现我不在了，就按照这上面的去做。"Su Qingyao的手slightly颤抖，她死死地盯着Chen Ji的眼睛："你……你在说什么？什么叫你不在了？"

Chen Ji轻轻握住她的手，声音很gentle："Qingyao，我不怕死。我怕的是……我死了之后，没人保护你们。"他顿了顿，"Ling Yuan、Ye Qing、Han Lie，甚至天道之眼，都不是最可怕的对手。真正可怕的是……"他抬起头，看向洞府外的天空，仿佛能穿透层层云层看到那冥冥中的存在，"是那个自以为是棋手，实际上也是棋子的天道意志。"Su Qingyao沉默了，她忽然踮起脚尖，在他的额头上落下一个轻轻的吻。"Chen Ji，我不会让你一个人扛。"她的声音很轻，却resolute得不容置疑。

Chen Ji愣住了，这一刻，他那张永远在calculating、永远在布局的脸上，终于露出了真正的touched。他伸出手，轻轻将Su Qingyao拥入怀中。洞府内很安静，只有两人的呼吸声交织在一起。许久，Chen Ji才whispered开口："Qingyao，谢谢你。"他没有说谢谢什么，但Su Qingyao懂了——谢谢她的trust，谢谢她的坚持，谢谢她在他最孤独的时候，愿意与他并肩而立。窗外，夕阳的余晖洒在摘星崖上，将一切都镀上了一层温暖的金色。而在那云海之上，一只无形的眼睛正静静地注视着这里——天道之眼，那超越时空的目光中，第一次流露出了一丝……忌惮。

dialogue.content: Chen Ji忽然抬头，目光仿佛穿透了一切屏障，直视那只冥冥中的眼睛。他笑了，那笑容里没有fearful，没有awe，只有纯粹的、不加掩饰的战意。"看够了吗？"他的声音很轻，却清晰地传入了那道意志之中，"第1155章，我等你。"天道之眼没有回应，只是slowly隐入虚空深处。但在消失之前，一道超越灵魂的信息传入了Chen Ji的脑海："有趣……千年来第一个敢直视本座的人类。破局者，本座expectant与你对弈的那一天。"Chen Ji闭上眼睛，嘴角的笑容却更深了——这一战，他必须赢，也一定会赢。

text.content: 维度危机暂时解除，天青宗的弟子们欢呼雀跃，以为劫难已过。只有Chen Ji知道，真正的暴风雨才刚刚开始。天机录的残页在他体内slowly流转，第十五页的知识已经完全解封——那是关于如何打破天道枷锁的终极秘法。但代价是，他的fate已经消耗过半，而下一次使用天机录预见第1155章的画面，将耗尽他最后的天命。"破局者……"他murmured自语，手中残页上的金色符文映照在他深邃的眼眸中，"既然天要亡我，那我就逆了这天！"窗外，星辰璀璨，仿佛无数双眼睛在注视着这个敢于挑战天道的男人。而在那遥远的天穹之上，一只无形的巨眼正slowly凝聚——终极决战的倒计时，已经开始。
